svg.title: IBM Sterling Transformation Extender in three of IBM’s counts
svg.desc: Three of IBM's counts for Sterling Transformation Extender: four Industry Packs, Financial Payments, Healthcare, Supply Chain EDI and SAP Applications; five supply chain standards in the Supply Chain EDI Industry Pack, X12, EDIFACT, RAILINC EDI, EAN and UPC; four cloud adapters named, AWS, MongoDB, HDFS and Kafka. Each count is of what IBM lists on its Sterling Transformation Extender page; they are not test results, and IBM states no conditions for them.
